hml.text: Sandruu is a latent planeswalker whom Feroz meets when he first arrives in the Homelands, and Feroz unearths a didgeridoo that summons Sandruu, and the two befriend each other.
Serra appears and kills a Root Spider that tricked and attacked Feroz and Sandruu.
Taysir of Rabiah defeats Sandruu and banishes him to a remote plane, but Feroz kills Taysir with a broadsword.
